question: Who among the following was awarded the Bharat Ratna for his contribution to the Green Revolution in India?
solution:
The correct answer is **__C__ __Subramaniam__.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• He was Instrumental in the launch of the **Green Revolution in India**, which transformed India's agricultural landscape.
 
• As **Minister of Agriculture**, he introduced high-yielding varieties of seeds and modern farming techniques.
 
• His efforts led India to achieve self-sufficiency in food production.
 
• He was awarded the **Bharat Ratna** in **1998** for his contributions to the Green Revolution.
 
• He worked closely with agricultural scientists like **Dr. M.S. Swaminathan** to improve India's crop yields.
